mobdefense.help.rocket_booster.what.1: TPU cradle for one firework rocket on top of the frame.
mobdefense.help.rocket_booster.what.2: Pushes along the nose at 2 g for any drone size (at most 60 N).
mobdefense.help.rocket_booster.what.4: Rockets with stars explode at the end – that hits the drone too.
